# Cavaleiros da Ilha (Knights of the Isle)

> Free pixel-art logic puzzle for iPhone and Android by Daenamu Studio. Knights only move by jumping over other pieces; get them all to the towers to win the island. Available in Portuguese (pt-BR), English, Spanish and Korean.

Official names by language:

- Português (pt-BR): Cavaleiros da Ilha
- English: Knights of the Isle
- Español: Caballeros de la Isla
- 한국어: 섬의 기사들

Key facts:

- Genre: logic puzzle, single player, pixel art
- Platforms: iOS (iPhone) and Android
- Price: free to play, supported by Google AdMob ads (optional rewarded videos and ads between levels); any in-app purchase is processed by Apple or Google
- Account: no sign-up or login; progress (levels, stars, coins, language, volume) is saved only on the device and is erased if the game is uninstalled
- Audience: general audience, all-ages ads only; not directed at children under 13
- Developer and publisher: Daenamu Studio
- Support: suporte@namustudio.com.br (replies in Portuguese, English or Spanish)
